messages:
maya: Quick check — can we gate the dashboard error-rate view behind the retention flag? want to avoid showing inflated numbers while rollup is in flight.
kevin: can you remind which flag? is this the new retention.v2 toggle?
elena: owner for the dash error view is me. dependency on metrics-pipeline for 30d rollup. currently blocked on their schema change.
jonathan: +1. data-pipeline PR merged today but needs a migration run in staging. ETA tomorrow EOD.
maya: ok thx. if migration is tomorrow, can we still do canary rollout next wed? need to confirm canary targets.
kevin: canary targets = 10% prod + two dedicated internal services: search and inbox
elena: i'll coordinate with search owners. pinging @jonathan for migration run ownership.
jonathan: i'll run migration and post logs. plan: run in staging at 09:30, then prod migration at 01:30 UTC w/ db replica.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: migration-job v3 -> staging @2361234600
maya: also note: retention UI needs tooltip update to reflect 'effective retention after dedup'. small copy change, assigning to @kevin
kevin: assigned, will send PR by EOD. linking snippet for tooltip text:
```
Effective retention: final retention window applied after deduplication and sampling. This may be shorter than raw retention.
```
elena: is there any risk to tracing hooks? the new rollup will drop some spans older than 7d unless preserved.
jonathan: good catch. we should add a KV cache for critical span IDs for 14d. I'll open a quick RFC.
maya: can we add this to milestone board? milestone: retention-rollout-2. owners: elena (dash), jonathan (ingest), kevin (ui). deps: metrics-pipeline migration, kv-cache patch.
kevin: added a card and tagged owners. leaving a note to include rollback playbook.
maya: thanks. if anyone sees a hard blocker please call in #eng-oncall. otherwise i'll send a short status update to PMs tomorrow.
elena: ack
jonathan: ack
ops-bot: migration-job completed staging -> success @2361234650 :white_check_mark:
kevin: PR up for tooltip: https://git.company/kevin/retention-tooltip (WIP)
maya: perfect. logging this as last update for now. will follow up after prod migration.
